findings:
🔴 [mux-strips-deny-ask] MUST-FIX `opt-in-multiplexer.js` now only extracts `additionalContext` from child JSON and discards every `permissionDecision`, including `"deny"`/`"ask"`; before the change child stdout was forwarded raw, so an opt-in PreToolUse child that denies via JSON on exit 0 is now silently allowed (gate bypass). Spec §3 hard requirement: preserve deny/ask (deny wins), strip only allow. Remediation: while merging, record the strongest decision (`deny` > `ask`) plus its `permissionDecisionReason` and include it in the single output object; add the missing test case for a denying child next to an advising child.
🟠 [exit2-paths-touched] MUST-FIX `mcp-health.js` pre branch (exit 2) and `orchestrator-edit-gate.js` block branch (exitCode 2) now emit stdout `additionalContext`; §2.5/KR3 require deny/exit-2 paths byte-for-byte unchanged and §3 scopes mcp-health to PostToolUseFailure only; test case 13 codifies the violation and the README mcp-health row advertises it. Remediation: revert both hunks (keep the stderr line only), delete test case 13, and restore the mcp-health README row to PostToolUseFailure only.
🟠 [mux-exit1-dropped] MUST-FIX multiplexer changed `status !== 0 ⇒ exitCode = status` to tracking only `status === 2`; a child exiting 1 (non-blocking error, stderr shown to the user) now yields multiplexer exit 0, silently downgrading the host behaviour outside the spec's "exit 2 exactly as today" clause. Remediation: keep a `nonZero` status for any child with status not in {0,2} and `process.exit(nonZero)` after writing the merged JSON.
🟠 [group-s-rewrite-race] MUST-FIX all three group-S writers append one line, then read the whole file and `writeFileSync` it back (truncate + rewrite, not atomic) and wrap any unparseable line into a synthetic `{text: <junk>}` entry; cost-tracker, check-console and batch-format run concurrently on the same Stop, so a partially truncated line can be dropped or re-emitted by the relay as an advisory that is not byte-identical to any hook text. Remediation: skip unparseable lines instead of wrapping them, and write the trimmed dump to `<qfile>.tmp.<pid>` followed by `renameSync` over the queue file.
🟠 [batch-format-tsc-not-queued] MUST-FIX spec §3 lists `batch-format.js` advisories at ~:57 and ~:71; the diff only enqueues the Prettier-warnings text (~:57). The tsc advisory remains stderr-only and never reaches the model. Remediation: apply the same inline enqueue block to the tsc output branch with `source: 'batch-format'`.
🟡 [reexpectations-missing] MUST-FIX §5 names `reload-watch-detects-mtime-change.test.sh:31`, `context-budget.test.js:157-161,552-558` and `cost-fuse.test.sh` case 4b as stdout-pinning assertions to re-expect; none is touched by the diff while the hooks now emit stdout JSON, so those suites go red (KR3), and no `run.sh` evidence is supplied. Remediation: re-expect those assertions (name each in the commit) and attach the full-suite run output.
🟡 [drop-debug-log-missing] MUST-FIX KR2/§3 require a debug-log line when an entry is evicted by the cap, discarded for age, or not enqueued for a missing/empty `session_id`; the writers' trim loops, the relay's age filter and the empty-sid branches emit nothing. Remediation: one `process.stderr.write` line per drop in each of those three places.
🔵 [test-runner-trailing-newlines] CUT/FOLLOW-UP `test-runner.js` strips `/\n+$/` while every other hook strips a single `\n`, so `additionalContext` can differ from stderr by trailing blank lines; the suite's `$(cat)` capture hides it. Excluded: no model-visible wording change, fix `/\n$/` in a follow-up.
🔵 [cost-tracker-duplicated-text] CUT/FOLLOW-UP the cost-tracker advisory string is written twice (stderr and `qtext`) instead of bound once; future edits can desynchronise the two. Excluded: the texts are identical today and the suite asserts equality.
